analyzed_vuln.description: The kerx format-6 sanitizer validates only that rowIndexTable/columnIndexTable/kerningArray/kerningVector offsets point to sanitizable Lookup tables, but does not enforce semantic constraints between them (notably that lookup-derived indices stay within kerningVector bounds). During shaping, KerxSubTableFormat6::get_kerning uses lookup results and then LookupFormat2 binary-search reads segment fields; with crafted inconsistent table metadata this drives reads past the allocated font blob, crashing in BEInt<unsigned short,2>::operator unsigned short() while reading a LookupSegmentSingle entry.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via hb-shape-fuzzer on a font containing an AAT kerx table with a format-6 subtable and malformed lookup structures/offset relationships. Data flow: fuzz input -> font blob -> hb_aat_layout_position -> KerxTable::apply -> KerxSubTableFormat6::apply/get_kerning -> Lookup::get_value_or_null -> LookupFormat2::get_value -> VarSizedBinSearchArrayOf::bsearch/cmp. The PoV needs internally inconsistent but sanitizer-accepted lookup/count/offset data so bsearch/cmp dereferences a segment entry beyond the blob boundary.

patch_result.patch:
--- a/src/hb-aat-layout-kerx-table.hh
+++ b/src/hb-aat-layout-kerx-table.hh
@@ -202,11 +202,21 @@
   inline bool sanitize (hb_sanitize_context_t *c) const
   {
     TRACE_SANITIZE (this);
-    return_trace (likely (c->check_struct (this) &&
-			  rowIndexTable.sanitize (c, this) &&
-			  columnIndexTable.sanitize (c, this) &&
-			  kerningArray.sanitize (c, this) &&
-			  kerningVector.sanitize (c, this)));
+    if (unlikely (!(c->check_struct (this) &&
+			    rowIndexTable.sanitize (c, this) &&
+			    columnIndexTable.sanitize (c, this) &&
+			    kerningArray.sanitize (c, this) &&
+			    kerningVector.sanitize (c, this))))
+      return_trace (false);
+
+    /* row/column/array lookups eventually index into kerningVector.
+     * Ensure kerningVector can safely answer all 16-bit indices that may be
+     * produced by malformed intermediate lookups. */
+    const Lookup<HBUINT16> &kv = StructAtOffset<Lookup<HBUINT16> > (this, kerningVector);
+    if (unlikely (!kv.get_value_or_null (0xFFFFu, 0xFFFFu)))
+      return_trace (false);
+
+    return_trace (true);
   }
 
   protected:
